calc_robux_per_usd.description: Calculator: Robux bought per 1 USD (standard packs ≈ 80).

calc_devex_usd_per_robux.description: Calculator: USD a creator gets per Robux when cashing out (DevEx).

calc_creator_share_percent.description: Calculator: % of a marketplace sale the creator keeps.

calc_premium_tiers.description: Calculator hub: Robux per month and USD price of each Roblox Premium plan (Basic/Pro/Elite).

games_list.description: Games screen. JSON array of { id, title, url, image?, category?, featured? }. url/image must be https. Replace the examples with real game links.

web_url.description: Custom Tab link(s), https. Several: separate with commas. Empty = Custom Tab off. Target by app version / country with conditions.

ads_enabled.description: Master ads switch. false = no ad cards or header ad icons anywhere (e.g. during Play Store review). Use conditions for country / app version.
